post.caption: Jacques Arpels of Van Cleef and Arpels picked four leaf clovers in his backyard and handed them to employees as good luck charms. He liked to say you have to believe in luck. Clover shapes were in the house archives by 1906. In 1968, the house launched its Alhambra collection, and the first piece was a long necklace of 20 clover motifs, each edged with tiny gold beads. The name is widely said to honor Granada's Alhambra palace. Later versions added mother of pearl and onyx, and Princess Grace of Monaco wore three Alhambra necklaces at once.
